name: nfl-engine-primary
environment_decision: Conda-forge has no Linux pandas 1.5.3 build for CPython 3.12. Pin Linux pandas 2.2.3, preserving Python 3.12.2, numpy 1.26.4, scipy 1.13.1, pyarrow 21.0.0 and requests 2.32.3. Require full regression and isolated synthetic checks before activation. Live lock/scorer arithmetic uses standard library; pandas is used for shadow preparation and research tests.
lock_decision: Durable ownership on engine-v2, no TTL or heartbeat-based takeover. Mac yields to cloud; an unreachable GitHub fails closed. A handoff requires fencing the previous worker and synchronizing captures, budget and first grades before changing owner.
path_decision: Use identical absolute checkout path on Linux to preserve existing pinned references without rewriting evidence.
publication_decision: Only engine-v2. Repository-scoped write deploy key, host pre-push branch guard. Capture receipts, quota ledger, immutable locks, daily inputs and grades are committed alongside the reader artifact.
host_secret_storage: /etc/nfl-engine/secrets.env, root:root mode 0600, injected by systemd; secret values never committed or logged.
host_sizing: Lowest available Basic size; 2 GiB swap and systemd memory limits. No backup add-on.
verification_scope: Cloud synthetic transport/capture/lock/grade, exact cross-platform picks/consensus, Linux regression suite, host artifact push, systemd production worker and daily finals refresh exits, Mac ownership yield. Next scheduled live Odds API capture is prospective.
